description:
Depends on opi-gfy.3 (Interactive as GenServer).

Currently do_run/1 starts Terminal, StdinFSM, Renderer, FooterData as bare linked processes and detects crashes via trapped :EXIT messages (interactive.ex:735-748). With Interactive as a GenServer, start these four under a child Supervisor with strategy :one_for_all (any one dying takes all down).

Changes:
- Start a Supervisor as a child of Interactive in init/1 (or start_link in do_run before GenServer.start_link)
- Remove Process.flag(:trap_exit, true) from run/1
- Remove handle_info({:EXIT, pid, reason}) clauses
- shutdown/4 becomes Supervisor.stop(sup) in terminate/2
title: Supervise TUI children under one_for_all Supervisor
